Discordia (portable) — about MicrosoftEdgeWebview2Setup.exe

Discordia draws its interface with the Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime.
Windows 11 and up-to-date Windows 10 already have it, so most people can
just run Discordia.exe and ignore this file.

If Discordia.exe opens with a blank window or complains that WebView2 is
missing, run MicrosoftEdgeWebview2Setup.exe once. It is Microsoft's official
Evergreen bootstrapper: a small stub that downloads and installs the runtime
from Microsoft, and exits without downloading anything if the runtime is
already present. It needs an internet connection.

This is the same bootstrapper the Discordia installer uses. Nothing else in
this folder depends on it, and you can delete it once WebView2 is installed.
